metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Rose bill, the comedy at the Theatre, Margery's report, and the night sentence.

yesterday: The yard was the biggest since Easter Monday. There were more apprentices than sweethearts. They were loud before the play and loud in it.
Garnish stopped at fifteen. The hush at the messenger came late and broke early.
Margery emptied the box. She said they laughed like men who mean to laugh at something else after. Richard shrugged. You kept her sentence.
Kemp danced the jig of the slippers. The yard kept him.
